verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.trymartin.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and indexes the docs as markdown links. The doc pages themselves are served as .md URLs, which gives an agent clean, machine-readable docs to follow. The 404 on the doubled '.md.md' path is a probe artifact, not a real gap. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated agent bundle, and no independent or hands-on report of agents actually using these docs.
